The specialist

Dr. Ajay Pandey

Dr. Pandey holds an MBBS and a DDVL (Diploma in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy), where he ranked first in his batch, along with an FAGE qualification. He runs Skin Cure in Telipara, Bilaspur, seeing patients for both routine skin concerns and laser-based skin and hair treatment.

Every appointment starts with a proper examination before any treatment plan is suggested — the clinic's approach stays close to medical dermatology rather than one-size-fits-all cosmetic fixes.

  • MBBS
  • DDVL — 1st Rank
  • FAGE
  • Laser skin & hair treatment
What we treat

Services at Skin Cure

Medical dermatology first, cosmetic procedures where they genuinely help — every case is examined before a treatment is recommended.

01

Acne & pimple care

Diagnosis-led treatment for active breakouts, scarring and recurring acne.

02

Pigmentation & dark spots

Treatment plans for uneven tone, dark patches and sun-related pigmentation.

03

Dry skin & rash

Management of dryness, eczema-type rashes and irritation with medical care.

04

General dermatology

Routine skin, nail and scalp procedures under medical supervision.
